subject.title: refactor(config): config-surface reduction tranche 3 — product consolidations (review request)

question: Should an existing explicit `systemAgent.rescue.enabled: false` setting continue to deny remote rescue after this consolidation, or may the product intentionally replace it with automatic YOLO owner-DM rescue?
rationale: The branch removes a user-controlled remote-command security boundary and its migration outcome cannot be selected mechanically without deciding the permanent product/security contract.

options.title: Preserve explicit denials
options.body: Add or retain a canonical migration outcome that keeps explicitly disabled rescue disabled, then prove Doctor preserves that outcome.

options.title: Adopt automatic YOLO rescue
options.body: Approve the intentional removal of the opt-out, document the upgrade/security change prominently, and prove the new effective policy after Doctor migration.

options.title: Split rescue retirement
options.body: Land only the independent consolidations and hold the rescue-policy removal for a dedicated security/product decision.

recommendation.title: Preserve explicit denials
recommendation.body: Add or retain a canonical migration outcome that keeps explicitly disabled rescue disabled, then prove Doctor preserves that outcome.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR body explicitly requests this decision and the supplied branch history concentrates the affected policy and migration work in this contributor's proposal.
